profile.headline: Software Engineer at EasyPost
profile.summary:
I graduated from Cal Poly Pomona with a degree in Mathematics (Pure Option). I then got hired at Blizzard Entertainment as a Quality Assurance Analyst. During my temp period I tested World of Warcraft quests and environments. I then got transferred to a small programming team still within the World of Warcraft QA team. 

I primarily worked on automation testing, web development and database management. I am a self taught programmer and am very driven to continue to learn more about programming. I am a very quick learner and have a learn-by-doing learning style. Over about 6 months of being on this team I have been assigned tasks where I had to teach myself LUA, Python, AutoIt, HTML, CSS, PHP, Javascript, JQuery, C#, Java, SQL queries, and C++ and produce products for the World of Warcraft QA team.

I left my position to pursue more education. I was admitted into App Academy where I learned more about web development through Ruby on Rails, Backbone and Javascript.
